primer_content.postwork:
1. The Imminent Post-Labor Reality: Why Automation Changes Everything

For thousands of years, human civilization operated on the iron rule: "He who does not work, neither shall he eat." Humanoid robotics, autonomous machinery, and generative AI are breaking that equation forever. When machines perform farming, construction, transportation, energy generation, and healthcare at near-zero marginal cost, human survival must be decoupled from employment.

⚠️ The Dystopian Default: Techno-Feudalism

Under current market rules, tech monopolies own the automated labor force. Billions become "unemployable," stripped of wages, and forced into extreme precarity while wealth concentrates into a handful of corporate oligarchs.

🌱 The O.N.E. Blueprint: Machine Liberation

The productive power of automation is declared the common heritage of all humanity. Machine labor frees human beings from drudgery, poverty, and wage servitude—making food, shelter, and energy free birthrights.
primer_content.failures:
2. Why Past Civilizational Models Failed

Throughout history, humanity tried four major civilizational operating systems. Every single one failed to produce lasting peace, equity, or ecological balance:

1. Religion
Failed
Holy wars, dogmatic superstition, and clergy hierarchies policing human minds with guilt and supernatural fear.
2. Feudalism
Failed
Hereditary monarchies owning land by "divine right," reducing ordinary people to serfs under the sword.
3. State Communism
Failed
Private landlords replaced by party dictators, central planning paralysis, and carceral state terror.
4. Capitalism
Failed
Compound debt, artificial scarcity, commodification of basic survival, and catastrophic planetary ecocide.

✨ The 5th Path: Open Networked Earth (O.N.E.)

Neither corporate exploitation nor state tyranny: usufruct care without landlordism, citizen lotteries without politicians, and guaranteed survival without money.
primer_content.pillars:
3. The Four Core Principles of O.N.E.

📜 Jump to Constitution →

⚡ 1. The Survival Baseline (Moneyless Society)

Every person born on Earth has an unconditional, lifelong birthright to pure water, nutritious food, modern housing, complete healthcare, and clean power. Survival is never a bargaining chip.

🏡 2. Property as Care, Not Speculation

Personal belongings (clothing, tools, books) are permanently protected. Family homes are held under secure possessory usufruct for life. Land speculation, rental exploitation, and evictions are strictly abolished.

🎲 3. Governance by Statistical Lottery

Elections breed billionaire donor capture, demagoguery, and corruption. Public policy is decided by sortition assemblies: ordinary citizens randomly drawn like trial juries, advised by competing panels of experts.

🌿 4. Ecological Exergy Limits

Infinite exponential growth on a finite planet is mathematical suicide. Economic accounting is denominated directly in thermodynamic metrics (kilowatt-hours, liters of water, topsoil regeneration), not paper fiat.
primer_content.roadmap:
4. The Transition Roadmap: How We Get There

🌱 Jump to Roadmap →

We do not wait for global collapse or violent revolution. O.N.E. spreads through a dual-track handshake: building the resilient new commons today while the legacy system falters.

🇨🇭 1. The Legal Armor (Swiss Verein)

Starting as an autonomous Swiss Association (ZGB Art. 60 ff.) holding open IP and assets with zero capital minimums and full member privacy.

🌱 2. Bioregional Seed Nodes

Three people can establish a local Community Land Trust (CLT), mutual-aid food forest, or microgrid using open-source O.N.E. governance covenants.

🤝 3. Non-Violent Civil Conversion

Unarmed civic peace guilds replace militarized policing with restorative de-escalation; corporate debt is cleared through universal jubilee.

🌍 4. Planetary Federation

Watershed councils federate into continental chambers, replacing nation-state rivalries with ecological and thermodynamic coordination.

roadmap.title: How to Build an Autonomous Seed Node
roadmap.desc: A concrete, step-by-step operational handbook for founders, engineers, and organizers: legally de-commodifying land, securing off-grid life support, organizing labor without bosses or wages, and establishing economic sovereignty within legacy society.
roadmap.shield_subtitle: Audited against 53 real-world legal, financial, and mechanical failure modes • Zero single points of failure (RSV-1: 0)
roadmap.sys1_desc: Separates passive real estate from commercial operations to protect the land from debts, taxes, and code enforcement:
roadmap.sys1_item1: Entity A (Passive Land Trust): Immutable asset-lock, zero commercial business, zero debt, zero mortgages.
roadmap.sys1_item2: Entity B (Operating Co-op): Absorbs commercial trading risks under a Universal Zero Unsecured Debt rule.
roadmap.sys1_item3: Demountable Personalty (UCC § 9-604 / ZGB 677): Tools remain tenant personalty; land cannot be seized.
roadmap.sys1_item4: Zoning Defense & Escrow: Road-legal ANSI A119.5 chassis + 12-month municipal compliance defense reserve.
roadmap.sys2_desc: Eliminates competence bottlenecks, chore vacuums, class stratification, and founder burnout:
roadmap.sys2_item1: Non-Waivable Metabolic Floor: 5–7 hrs/wk of biological chores (cooking, latrine, firewood) required of every adult.
roadmap.sys2_item2: Tier 0 Apprenticeship Pairs: 400V microgrids, deep wellheads, and legal defense require certified lead + apprentice.
roadmap.sys2_item3: Castell Trapped-Key Interlocks: Mechanical key sequences physically prevent arc-flash and dry pump cavitation.
roadmap.sys2_item4: ULCAA / Subchapter T Safe Harbor: Internal work structured as non-employee mutual aid, defeating FLSA wage claims.
roadmap.sys3_desc: Generates fiat for property taxes and microchips via cognitive freelancing without burning out contributors:
roadmap.sys3_item1: Capped Freelance Consulting: Cognitive contributors capped at 15–20 billable hrs/wk to preserve node life balance.
roadmap.sys3_item2: 50% Upfront Retainer Rule: External contracts mandate 50% upfront deposits backed by a 90-day cash trade reserve.
roadmap.sys3_item3: Decoupled Compute Micro-Array: Workstations and transceivers powered by an isolated 2.5 kW / 10 kWh solar buffer.
roadmap.sys3_item4: Demonetized Domestic Sanctuary: Zero fiat currency circulates inside Track B; basic food, water, and shelter are unconditional.
roadmap.sys4_desc: Guarantees somatic survival during polar vortex freezes, grid blackouts, and supply chain interdictions:
roadmap.sys4_item1: 40,000L Cistern + 48V DC Bypass: Subgrade freeze-proof tank + deep-well pump with manual 48V battery bypass.
roadmap.sys4_item2: 48V LFP Battery Vault: Automated BMS cold-throttling (≤0.15C below 15°C; 0C below 0°C) stops dendrite plating.
roadmap.sys4_item3: 180-Day Bulk Caloric Cache: Sealed grains/legumes with daily enzymatic sprouting (600% Vit C boost) in root cellars.
roadmap.sys4_item4: 50 m² Thermal Core (-25°F): Super-insulated shelter-in-place micro-zone with sub-soil Canadian earth tubes.

roadmap.qa_desc: How seed node teams solve municipal building code citations, creditor lawsuits, chore fatigue, and sub-zero polar vortex freezes.
roadmap.q1_question: 🏛️ What if county building inspectors red-tag our tiny homes and dry toilets?
roadmap.q1_answer: Common Law Defense: Human living quarters deploy road-legal, DOT-certified demountable mobile chassis (ANSI A119.5 Park Model RVs) maintaining functioning axles and quick-disconnect utility couplings. Under state property law, these remain demountable personalty, not permanent real estate fixtures subject to standard residential building codes (IRC Appendix Q). Workshop structures utilize Agricultural Utility Exemptions (IBC § 105.2), while Entity B maintains a 12-month Municipal Indemnity Escrow to resolve code citations without clouding Entity A’s land title.
roadmap.q2_question: 📉 What if an external client defaults and an equipment supplier sues for $180,000?
roadmap.q2_answer: The Two-Tier Shield in Action: The Operating Cooperative (Entity B) absorbs commercial trading insolvency while the underlying Land Trust (Entity A) remains completely insulated. Under In re Owens Corning, bankruptcy courts reject substantive consolidation because the Land Trust conducted zero business and maintained segregated accounts. Under UCC § 9-604, trade creditors can only sever and repossess commercial workshop machinery on demountable pads; they have zero statutory right to foreclose on fee simple land or seize debt-free Tier 0 water and power assets.
roadmap.q3_question: 💻 What if high-earning software contributors refuse to do manual chores?
roadmap.q3_answer: The Non-Waivable Metabolic Floor: Every adult communard must contribute 5 to 7 hours per week of core biological chores (cooking, latrine maintenance, water management). This baseline cannot be bought out with cash or offset by cognitive hours, preventing founder burnout and class stratification. During client crunches, contributors may activate a temporary Client Crunch Exemption to hire mechanical contractors for general tasks, but they must still complete their 5–7 hr biological floor.
roadmap.q4_question: ❄️ What if winter temperatures plunge to -25°F for 3 consecutive weeks?
roadmap.q4_answer: Thermodynamic Core Resilience: The node retreats into its 50 m² super-insulated, earth-bermed Thermal Core Shelter-in-Place micro-zone, surviving on passive thermal mass and sub-soil geothermal earth tubes. LFP batteries in subgrade vaults are protected by BMS multi-step charge throttling (≤0.15C below 15°C; 0C below 0°C) and generator waste heat ducted into the vault. Heavy fab-lab machinery is automatically shed below 80% battery state of charge, while the 180-day bulk caloric cache guarantees food security.
